column3: Saori Route ・ Meeting With Her
I said calm down! You're getting too worked up.
...Stop acting so high and mighty when you don't know anything!
I at least know more than you!
What's with that? She consulted with you, so you think you're all that?
Why are you getting mad at me?!
You share the same crime. You didn't tell me about this, either.
Hey! Don't get violent!
You two were hiding this from me, how petty is that!
...Um... sorry...
It's too late to apologize.
Then, I will give you something as an apology.
Perhaps you would enjoy doujinshi of your favorite Meruru or something, how about that...?
I don't want one, so just stop hiding things from me.
You have no idea how worried people were...
Hey, why didn't you say anything?
Do you think I'm just a nuisance?
There's no way I would think that.
Then why didn't you want to talk to me?
It's not that... It's just that this is a delicate subject...
Even so, tell me!
Don't get so angry. Saori had her reasons...
I can see that just by looking...
Kiririn-shi...
Then you shouldn't be getting so upset at her then, right?
I don't wanna hear your excuses.
Kirino...
Is it that she was hurt by being left out of the loop...?
Is that why she is so worked up?
...What do you want? Looking at me like that...
Is it fun shunning me?
We're not shunning you.
I doubt it.
Now I can't even trust you. Well, I couldn't to begin with, anyway...
Don't get so angry. Saori had her reasons...
Yeah, I can see that...
Kiririn-shi...
Then you shouldn't be getting so upset at her, right?
I don't wanna hear your excuses.
Tch... Your silence tells me I'm right.
Y-You're wrong!
About what?
I just misread the timing, or rather...
Anyway, there was a reason I couldn't tell you...
Nice excuse.
It's not an excuse!
Well, that's how it sounds...
Isn't she just going to rehabilitate herself anyway?
This is your own hobby, right? Why do you have to quit it just because someone told you to?
That's what I told Saori, too!
Can you not interrupt when people are talking?
Ugh...
*ahem* Well...
It sounds like you just stood there and listened like an idiot. I'll compliment you for that, though...
I understand what you are trying to say.
As that may be... Saori has been really worried about this.
I wasn't asking you.
A-Ah...
Hey... What do you think about otakus?
Me? Well...
...What do I think about them?
Otakus are what they are, they like games and anime...
Nothing more, nothing less...
Not going to answer? Then I'll talk.
It is a lifestyle, not just a hobby.
If you just throw it away, it would be like making yourself disappear.
Kirino...
What... can't say anything?
Well, Saori. How about you?
So, what is the situation?
That's... But, Saori has to do what she can...
What she can do? If she fails, is there any meaning?
You fight to win. Why don't you understand that?
You don't even know how hard she's trying, don't just say whatever pleases you.
Of course I don't know. You two have been hiding this from me.
That's... true. But, can't you see from looking at her that she's been through a lot?
...Nope.
Nope, she says... Argh!
...Well, that is true.
Hmmm. You're not denying it?
Nope, this is the result of our "challenge".
But... Saori hasn't lost yet! She's been fighting splendidly, and the result...
And the result is if you lose, it will all be meaningless.
Ugh...
...I won't accept it unless you win.
If you don't leave any results, you will only have self satisfaction.
...Are you giving your own stance on it?
You can't just reset like in a game... Competitions aren't won that easily.
You can't go on like that.
Ah, it's pitiful but, I can't say anything...
And you... You keep saying Saori this, Saori that, stop pushing yourself on her.
If you want to settle this after hearing her out, you better show me you're at least willing to go to her fiance's house and explode.
Why do I have to blow up!?
It's just an example. Show me you're that serious.
You don't have to blow up, you can just sink into Tokyo Bay after tying yourself onto an anchor.
You're just trying to kill me in your mind, aren't you?
That's my point, you must be willing to die.
...There's logic to what you're saying.
I was irresponsible when consulting Saori this time.
No... you were not.
No, marriage is a problem between two people. It wasn't my place to intervene.
If you had a problem you could not solve, having someone intervene is something to be thankful for.
If you want someone to intervene, you would consult someone, right?
If you want to be approved or denied, you seek an opinion, right?
Being told that you're wrong is better than being ignored.
I see...
You're the same as Saori.
I only see you as sneakily running away.
We're not running, we're just at a loss for what to do!
On the contrary, there is nowhere to run. We're at a dead end here.
If there is no way out, why not make one?
Easier said than done...
You used me as an escape route.
Huh?
Because you were lost over your hobby, you thought nothing more could happen and came to me, right?
Where did your determination go? Don't tell me you can't do something you've already done!
Kirino...
I think I understand what she's trying to say. Only kind of, though.
Hey you, with the spiral glasses.
If you've been listening, why don't you say something?
Kiririn-shi...
Running away, you say...
I wasn't asking you.
Being decisive right here and now, huh...
I was asking Saori.
Kirino...
After hearing all of this, if you are still denying it... you're just running away.
Damn... How should I respond to this...
Kiririn-shi, I...
Saori, if you are angry at Kirino's words, you should say something.
Huh? If you have something to say, I'll listen.
